svg.text: How background work flows · the user waits only for the first step · every failure path ends in a dead-letter queue and an alarm
A · Unlocking a contact and delivering the lead
The seeker waits only for the transaction. Delivery happens in the background and is never lost.
1 Take one credit from the right lot
B · Uploading a photo or document
Nothing is served or opened until it has been scanned and checked. Users upload straight to S3, not through our servers.
clean documents only · expiring links for reviewers
C · Scheduled jobs and keeping search current
Money-changing jobs reuse the same tested ledger code as the application.
Rule behind every lane: the user waits only for what must be correct now. Everything else is queued, retried, and ends in a dead-letter queue with an alarm, never silently lost.
